leakage_mechanism_description: Every single instance where danger_ratio >= 1.0 (water_level >= danger_level) is labelled CRITICAL (except one high river benchmark where water_level was right at danger level). It directly encodes the CWC hydraulic danger threshold.
recommended_remediation: Remove from input features if predicting flood danger alert; or replace target with an independently observed physical outcome (e.g. verified inundation depth or village submergence).

leakage_mechanism_description: In combination with barrage site identity (latitude/longitude), raw water level reproduces the exact same threshold rule as danger_ratio.
recommended_remediation: Keep only as physical input if target is independent ground-truth damage/inundation rather than gauge threshold classification.

leakage_mechanism_description: Rainfall intervals are mutually exclusive across classes: LOW [10.0, 45.0], MODERATE [75.0, 142.6], HIGH [165.0, 194.5], CRITICAL [225.2, 383.0]. A single 1D decision tree on rainfall_mm achieves 100% training and test accuracy without any hydrological reasoning.
recommended_remediation: Train on real spatiotemporal gridded IMD rainfall data where rainfall distributions overlap between flooded and non-flooded catchments.

leakage_mechanism_description: Flow rate correlates strongly with warning tiers (e.g., Godavari 1st warning at 1.0M cusecs, 2nd warning at 1.3M, 3rd warning at 1.8M cusecs).
recommended_remediation: Retain as a causal hydrological predictor, but decouple target definition from administrative warning discharge triggers.

leakage_mechanism_description: Correlates with cyclone presence, but does not directly compute river flood stage. Acts as genuine multi-hazard covariate.
Identifies specific barrages (e.g. Dowleswaram 16.94N, Prakasam 16.51N), allowing model to memorize station danger elevations.
recommended_remediation: Normalize by catchment characteristics rather than raw station coordinates to enable spatial transferability.

leakage_mechanism_description: Provides barrage location context alongside latitude.
recommended_remediation: Replace with upstream basin area and elevation relative to sea level.
